data.one_liner: Flutter package for sending Snowplow analytics events on Android, iOS, and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a wrapper around Snowplow native trackers to manually or automatically track screen views, custom events, and context data. Supports multiple trackers, session handling, GDPR, and media tracking across platforms.
use_when: You need Snowplow analytics in a Flutter app
You want a single API for Android, iOS, and Web tracking
avoid_when: You prefer a different analytics platform
You need a pure Dart/HTTP‑only solution without native plugins
strengths: Full feature parity with Snowplow native SDKs
Automatic view tracking and session management
weaknesses: Requires native setup for each platform
data.setup_notes: Add the package, configure native iOS/Android trackers, and for Web include the Snowplow JS tracker in index.html. No extra permissions beyond network access are needed.
